brief:
Israeli airstrikes have killed at least 16 schoolchildren in Gaza since the start of November, according to the Gaza ministry, The Guardian reported. The death toll follows an airstrike on a residential apartment in Gaza City that killed two sisters, aged 15 and 13.

The report comes as young people across the territory face intensifying attacks during the ongoing conflict.

title: Israeli strikes kill 16 schoolchildren in Gaza this month
